# rwx_group_service_account_membership (Resource)

Manages one direct service-account membership in a group. The service account inherits the group's permissions. See [the docs](https://www.rwx.com/docs/service-accounts#permissions) for more information on how service accounts and groups work together. Requires `group:manage` on the group to add or remove membership; `service_account:manage` is not required. Server authorization and safety checks apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rwx_group" "automation" {
  name = "automation"
}

resource "rwx_service_account" "builder" {
  display_name = "Builder"
}

resource "rwx_group_service_account_membership" "builder" {
  group_id           = rwx_group.automation.id
  service_account_id = rwx_service_account.builder.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group to join. Changing this replaces the membership.
- `service_account_id` (String) The ID of the service account joining the group. Changing this replaces the membership.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The membership identity, in group-id/service-account-id format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rwx_group_service_account_membership.builder group-id/service-account-id
```
